u1.q: He ___ a postcard to his grandma yesterday.
u1.explain: yesterday 用一般过去时，write 的过去式是 wrote。

u1.q: We ___ some old friends in the museum.
u1.explain: 叙述过去的事用过去式 met。

u1.q: The past form of eat is ate.
u1.explain: eat 是不规则动词，过去式 ate。

u1.q: I didn't buy ___ in the shop.
u1.explain: 否定句中用 anything 表示“任何东西”。

u1.q: There is ___ (something / anything) delicious in the fridge.
u1.explain: 肯定句用 something 表示“某样好吃的”。

u1.q: — Did you go with ___? — No, I went alone.
u1.explain: 疑问句表“和某人一起”用 someone。

u1.q: We use indefinite pronouns like everyone and something to talk about unknown people or things.
u1.explain: 复合不定代词用来指代不确定的人或事物。

u1.q: She ___ (have) a great time at the beach.
u1.explain: 过去时态，have 的过去式是 had。

u1.q: Which are correct simple past forms?
u1.explain: eat 的过去式是 ate，不是 eated。

u1.q: Everyone ___ (was / were) tired after the trip.
u1.explain: everyone 作主语时谓语用单数 was。

u2.q: — ___ do you read books? — Every day.
He ___ eats breakfast, so he is hungry at noon.
u2.explain: 从“中午就饿”推断他从不吃早餐，用 never。

u2.q: We use how often to ask about frequency.
u2.explain: How often 用来提问动作发生的频率。

u2.q: There is ___ (many / much) water in the glass.
u2.explain: water 不可数，用 much 修饰。
quickly 是方式副词，不是频度副词。

u2.q: We say 'a piece of bread' because bread is uncountable.
u2.explain: bread 不可数，需用量词 a piece of。

u2.q: ___ students in our class like sports.
u2.explain: students 可数复数，用 Many 修饰。

u2.q: I eat fruit ___ (two / twice) a day.
u2.explain: 表示“两次”用 twice，不是 two。

u2.q: Most of my friends ___ (exercise / exercises) on weekends.
u2.explain: friends 复数，谓语用原形 exercise。

u3.q: This box is ___ than that one.
u3.explain: 两者比较用比较级 heavier。

u3.q: She is as ___ as her brother.
u3.explain: as...as 原级比较，用原级 tall。

u3.q: We add -er to short adjectives to make the comparative.
u3.explain: 短形容词加 -er 构成比较级。
friendly 以 -ly 结尾，变比较级为 friendlier。

u3.q: The weather today is ___ (hot) than yesterday.
u3.explain: hot 为重读闭音节，双写 t 加 er：hotter。
多音节词用 more 构成比较级。

u3.q: Both of them like music means only one of them likes music.
u3.explain: both 表示“两者都”，不是只有一个。
than 提示比较级，many 的比较级是 more。

u3.q: The ___ (much) you read, the smarter you become.
u3.explain: “the + 比较级…, the + 比较级…”句型，用 more。

u4.q: This is the ___ movie I have ever seen.
u4.explain: ever 提示最高级，good 的最高级是 best。
最高级 cheapest；cheap 直接加 -est。

u4.q: We use the before a superlative adjective.
— Which do you like ___ , A or B? — A.
u4.explain: 两者选择用比较级 better。
smaller 是比较级，不是最高级。

u4.q: We use 'or' to give a choice between two things.
u4.explain: 选择疑问句用 or 连接两个选项。

u4.q: It has the ___ (friendly) service in town.
One of the ___ (popular) songs is this one.
u4.explain: one of + the + 最高级 + 复数名词，用 most popular。

u4.q: The seat is the most ___ (comfort) in the cinema.

u4.explain: in your class 范围内用最高级 best。

u5.explain: decide 后接不定式 to do。

u5.q: We use to + verb (infinitive) after want and hope.
A ___ is a show with a funny situation and characters.
u5.explain: 情景喜剧 sitcom 以搞笑情境和人物为特点。

u5.q: Which words can be followed by to do?
u5.explain: enjoy 后接 doing，不是 to do。

u5.q: News is an uncountable noun, so we can say 'a news'.
u5.explain: news 不可数，不能说 a news。
需用形容词 educational（有教育意义的）。
would like 后接 to do。

u5.q: — What do you think ___ the game show? — It's OK.
u5.explain: think of 表示“认为……怎么样”。
